body.p: After the Phase 1 gate. Owns src/regex.c, src/regex_internal.h, src/regex_unicode.c, tools/generate-regex-tables.py, new src/function_library_regex.c, tests/regex_test.c. behind the interface: the whole F&O 4.0 dialect (category and block escapes \p{Lu} \p{IsGreek}, subtraction, back-references, reluctant quantifiers, non-capturing groups, ^ $ in multi-line mode, flags s m i x q, the 4.0 additions the suite uses including lookaround and name escapes), case-blind matching with Unicode case data (src/function_library_case.c tables), step limit (), no recursion. New part: analyze-string, matching-segments, regex. Done when fn-matches.re, fn-matches, fn-replace, fn-tokenize, fn-analyze-string ≥ 95% and the 480 FORX0002 failures of 1.25 are gone. Spec: F&O 4.0 "Regular expression syntax"; XSD 1.1 Part 2 appendix G. Done 2026-10-17 (, ): fn-matches.re 1082/1082, fn-matches 198/200, fn-replace 185/187, fn-tokenize 68/71, fn-analyze-string 29/30 (all ≥ 95%); no FORX0002 failure left in XP40 (561 before). fn-matching-segments 36/38 and fn-regex 25/30 wait for named record types and fn:format-integer. Also moved fn:matches, fn:replace and fn:tokenize to the new part.
